## Modified Unfolded Circle derivatives — CC BY 4.0

The following files are derivatives of Unfolded Circle Remote 3 artwork:

- `images/remote-3-dark-front-backlight.webp`
- `images/remote-3-dark-front-backlight-min.webp`
- `images/remote-3-dark-backlight-mask.png`

Copyright in the original artwork © 2024–2026 Unfolded Circle ApS. The original artwork and these derivatives remain licensed under CC BY 4.0.

Modified by Justin Jäger / Unfolded.Tools on 2026-08-04.

The modifications comprise:

- simulator-only dark Remote 3 front artwork with transparent button symbols;
- a resized and optimized simulator-only derivative for smaller displays; and
- a generated mask used to render the configured RGB button-backlight color and brightness.
